name: The majority voted against a [motion](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/debate/?id=2024-03-25.36.1) introduced by Melbourne MP [Adam Bandt](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/representatives/melbourne/adam_bandt) (Greens), which means it failed. ### Motion text > *That so much of the standing and sessional orders be suspended as would prevent the question for the second reading of the [Offshore Petroleum and Greenhouse Gas Storage Legislation Amendment (Safety and Other Measures) Bill 2024](https://www.aph.gov.au/Parliamentary_Business/Bills_Legislation/Bills_Search_Results/Result?bId=r7149) being put to the House for decision only when the Government's promised environmental reform package has passed both houses.* Standing and session orders are the usual procedural rules of parliament.
